about: Thresholds behind room.py's deterministic checks. Each one has a source note and how firm it is: 'platform' means the platform documents it; 'practitioner' means it is common agency practice, not a platform rule. Platforms change these, so every check that uses them is a warning to verify, never a proof. A brief can override any value by stating its own. Amounts are USD; for other currencies room.py applies them as rough equivalents and says so.

meta.source: Meta Business Help Center: an ad set leaves the learning phase after about 50 optimization events in the 7 days after its last significant edit.

tiktok.source: TikTok Ads Manager guidance: about 50 conversions per ad group within 7 days to exit learning.

google.source: Google Ads Smart Bidding guidance and common practice: about 30 conversions in 30 days per campaign for Target CPA to work reliably; Target ROAS wants more.

linkedin.source: LinkedIn Campaign Manager minimum daily budget of 10 USD per campaign.

tiktok.source: TikTok Ads Manager minimum daily budget of 20 USD per ad group (50 USD per campaign).

meta.source: Common Meta practice: 3 to 6 creatives per ad set, refreshed every 2 to 4 weeks as frequency climbs and performance fatigues.

tiktok.source: Common TikTok practice: at least 3 creatives per ad group, refreshed every 1 to 2 weeks because fatigue is fast.

linkedin.source: Common LinkedIn practice: 2 to 4 ads per campaign, refreshed every 4 to 6 weeks.

youtube.source: Common YouTube practice: at least 2 video cuts per campaign (for example a 6s bumper and a 15 to 30s cut).
